{"metadata":{"description":"在 DeepSeek Harness 里管理 Android SDK 与模拟器：23 个原生 android_* 工具覆盖环境探测、AVD 与模拟器生命周期、Kotlin/Compose 脚手架、Gradle 构建运行与安装启动，并提供设置页 | Android SDK and emulator management in DeepSeek Harness: 23 native android_* tools for SDK discovery, AVD and emulator lifecycle, Kotlin/Compose scaffolding","id":"gh:1422373411","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-android-emulator-helper","slug":"zhz8888/dsh-android-emulator-helper","topics":["adb","android","android-emulator","avd","deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin","emulator","gradle","jetpack-compose","kotlin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"在 DeepSeek Harness 里管理 Android SDK 与模拟器：23 个原生 android_* 工具覆盖环境探测、AVD 与模拟器生命周期、Kotlin/Compose 脚手架、Gr"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"adle 构建运行与安装启动，并提供设置页 | Android SDK and emulator management in DeepSeek Harness: 23 native android_*"},{"id":"p1s3","text":" tools for SDK discovery, AVD and emulator lifecycle, Kotlin/Compose scaffolding"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-android-emulator-helper"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**English** | 简体中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) native port of the official ZCode `android-emulator@0.1.0` plugin: all 23 o"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"riginal MCP tools preserved as native DSH tools, plus a **parameter page on the plugin row's own pag"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"e** in the Plugins panel (Plugins → Installed plugins → Android Emulator Helper → **Configure**) tha"},{"id":"p4s4","text":"t edits the SDK, emulator, system-image, build and output parameters in-app instead of through envir"},{"id":"p4s5","text":"onment variables, and **the same page as a section in the Settings dialog** once its **Show in Setti"},{"id":"p4s6","text":"ngs** switch is on and saved, with its own line-art Android icon."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"- Tool and argument names are identical to the original, so workflows written for its `android_emula"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"tor` MCP server keep working; the port adds no tool and drops none.
- 18 settings fields in 6 groups"},{"id":"p5s3","text":", all live-editable; the seven fields the original exposed still fall back to their `ANDROID_PLUGIN_"},{"id":"p5s4","text":"*` variable, then to the built-in default.
- The page opens from the plugin row's **Configure** cont"},{"id":"p5s5","text":"rol, so the bundle's detail page keeps its description, its rows and its source; the **Show in Setti"},{"id":"p5s6","text":"ngs** switch in the page's last card also adds the same form to the **Settings** dialog's navigation"},{"id":"p5s7","text":", drawn with a line-art Android head as its icon. It is off by default, so a fresh profile keeps one"},{"id":"p5s8","text":" configuration page.
- The default AVD is picked from a dropdown of the AVDs on this machine that st"},{"id":"p5s9","text":"ill have their payload: AVD discovery scans the AVD directory (`ANDROID_AVD_HOME`, then `$ANDROID_US"},{"id":"p5s10","text":"ER_HOME/avd`, then `~/.android/avd`) as well as asking `emulator -list-avds`, so the list survives a"},{"id":"p5s11","text":" host where the emulator cannot be started.

Reload or restart DSH afterwards."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## Requirements"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"| Dependency | Notes |"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"| Android SDK | `sdkPath` on the plugin's configuration page, else `ANDROID_HOME`, `ANDROID_SDK_ROOT"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"`, the Windows registry, the project's `local.properties`, then the common install paths on every dr"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"ive. |
| Platform tools, emulator and a system image | `adb` and `emulator` come from the SDK; an AV"},{"id":"p14s4","text":"D needs a system image for the API level you target. When `adb` is missing from `PATH`, the SDK's ow"},{"id":"p14s5","text":"n `platform-tools` copy is used instead: a last-resort search looks for it inside the SDK the diagno"},{"id":"p14s6","text":"stic found, and on Windows also under the drive roots, because a machine with the SDK installed must"},{"id":"p14s7","text":" not be reported as having no `adb`. |
| JDK | `jdkMajor` (`17` by default) selects the JDK a build "},{"id":"p14s8","text":"runs on; the nearest installed JDK is used when that major is missing, and the generated project's J"},{"id":"p14s9","text":"VM target follows the JDK in use and is clamped to [17, 21]. |
| Gradle | `android_build_app` uses t"},{"id":"p14s10","text":"he project's `./gradlew` when it has one and `gradle` from `PATH` otherwise; a generated wrapper is "},{"id":"p14s11","text":"pinned to the installed Gradle's version but never below **8.9**, the floor the bundled Android Grad"},{"id":"p14s12","text":"le Plugin 8.7.3 accepts. The project `android_create_app` writes ships no wrapper either. |
| A devi"},{"id":"p14s13","text":"ce or an AVD | An attached device, or an AVD to boot; `autoStartEmulator` decides whether the tools "},{"id":"p14s14","text":"may boot one themselves. |
| Node.js ≥ 22 | The DSH host runtime. |"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"`android_preflight` checks every item above and prints a fix for each failure; the plugin page's **R"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"un diagnostic** button runs the same checks."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## Known limitations"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"- **A machine with no global Gradle cannot build a generated project.** `android_create_app`
writes "},{"id":"p17s2","text":"no `gradlew`, and `android_build_app` can only generate one by running the
`gradle` it finds on `PAT"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"H`; without one it fails with an explicit message. Install
Gradle once, or run `gradle wrapper` in t"},{"id":"p17s4","text":"he project root yourself.
- **A generated project needs `compileSdk` 35 or newer.** The template pin"},{"id":"p17s5","text":"s
`androidx.core:core-ktx` 1.15.0, whose `minCompileSdk` is 35; `android_create_app`
refuses an olde"},{"id":"p17s6","text":"r level instead of writing a project Gradle cannot configure.
- **A batch-file tool cannot carry an "},{"id":"p17s7","text":"argument holding a defined `%NAME%` reference.**
`gradlew.bat`, `avdmanager.bat` and any other `.bat"},{"id":"p17s8","text":"`/`.cmd` launcher run through
`cmd.exe`, which expands such a reference even inside quotes; the call"},{"id":"p17s9","text":" refuses the
argument instead of letting it be silently rewritten. A bare `%` — including the
`%s` e"},{"id":"p17s10","text":"scapes `input text` sends for spaces — is safe.
- **Linux is unsupported**, exactly as in the origin"},{"id":"p17s11","text":"al; `android_preflight` reports it.
- `android_start_emulator` always starts a new emulator and neve"},{"id":"p17s12","text":"r reuses one. Pass `serial` to the other tools to reuse a target.
- `android_create_avd` always answ"},{"id":"p17s13","text":"ers `no` to `avdmanager`'s confirmation, so it can never silently trigger a multi-gigabyte image dow"},{"id":"p17s14","text":"nload; install the image with `sdkmanager` first.
- UI automation depends on the device-side `uiauto"},{"id":"p17s15","text":"mator`. When it is unavailable `android_ui_status` reports that, and the build, run and screenshot p"},{"id":"p17s16","text":"aths are unaffected.
- The configuration page's installed-image list comes from scanning the SDK dir"},{"id":"p17s17","text":"ectory, not from `sdkmanager --list_installed`, which fails in restricted environments and prefixes "},{"id":"p17s18","text":"its output with deprecation notices.
- The configuration page's two routes are served by the plugin "},{"id":"p17s19","text":"and are mounted in a real profile, but their HTTP responses cannot be exercised outside the GUI: the"},{"id":"p17s20","text":" desktop app authenticates every request, so a bare `curl` to `/api/android-emulator-helper/status` "},{"id":"p17s21","text":"answers `403 forbidden` before the handler runs. The page's spacing, dark theme and narrow-width wra"},{"id":"p17s22","text":"pping still deserve a human look in the GUI.
